comment: The eight repeat CV jacks, inputs 8 to 15, are built and named but never read: the repeat count comes from the knob alone, and the panel artwork draws an arrow from each of them into its repeat knob, so they are tagged to a line saying nothing reads them. The width CV inputs exist in the code with no jack on the panel. The maker's configOutput call in the loop omits its index, so only output 0 carries a tooltip name and the other seven are blank; all eight are step outputs.
